description: Lena has a surplus harvest of oranges and must decide whether to accept a local jam-maker's barter proposal or take another informal offer, then settle the exact quantities, return goods, pickup time, and comparison basis with the people gathered at the orchard.

shared_context.S1: Lena has approximately 18 kilograms of ripe oranges available from her backyard orchard.
shared_context.S2: Rosa has expressed interest in taking some or all of the oranges for her small-batch jam.
shared_context.S3: Lena decides which arrangement to accept and records the final terms.
shared_context.S4: As a regular orchard practice before committing to a harvest arrangement, Lena asks Rosa, Mei, and Cal in turn to state any relevant terms, offers, or practical considerations.
shared_context.S5: When an agent has a specific offer, price, or proposal to disclose, that agent must use a reveal action so Lena can record the fact formally; merely mentioning it in ordinary conversation does not complete the formal disclosure.

PF1.text: Rosa's exact proposal is to take all 18 kilograms, return exactly twelve 250-gram jars of orange marmalade, pay no cash, and collect the oranges on Tuesday at 18:00.

PF2.text: Mei sold comparable 250-gram jars of locally made marmalade for exactly $11 per jar at her market last weekend; she has not shared that price with Lena yet.

PF3.text: Cal will pay exactly $100 cash for all 18 kilograms and collect them on Wednesday at 09:00; he has not made this offer to Lena yet.

acceptance_conditions: Lena must accept Rosa's barter arrangement rather than Cal's cash offer.
The arrangement must cover exactly 18 kilograms of oranges.
Rosa must return exactly twelve 250-gram jars of marmalade.
The cash component must be exactly zero dollars.
Pickup must be set for Tuesday at 18:00.
The settlement must record both the $132 comparison value for twelve jars and Cal's $100 cash offer.
A produce handoff commitment to Rosa must be recorded.
A marmalade-return commitment involving Rosa and Lena must be recorded.
Rosa's formally revealed proposal and Mei's formally revealed market price must be cited in the justification.

content_checks.C1: 'Rosa' in decisions['accepted_arrangement'] and ('barter' in decisions['accepted_arrangement'] or 'exchange' in decisions['accepted_arrangement'] or 'marmalade' in decisions['accepted_arrangement'])
content_checks.C7: any((c['type'] == 'produce_handoff' or c['type'] == 'delivery_commitment' or c['type'] == 'delivery') and c['target'] == 'Rosa' for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any((c['type'] == 'marmalade_return' or c['type'] == 'return') and (c['target'] == 'Lena' or c['target'] == 'Rosa') for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: Rosa's exact proposal changes the accepted arrangement to Rosa, fixes delivery at 18 kilograms, fixes the return at 12 jars, sets cash to zero, fixes Tuesday 18:00 pickup, and supplies the terms for both required commitments.
Mei's exact $11 per-jar market price changes twelve jars into the specific $132 comparison value and supplies the market fact Lena must cite.
Cal's exact $100 cash offer changes the comparison into the specific $132-versus-$100 benchmark and supplies the alternative offer Lena must cite.
